The '''Interstellar Travel Council''' was an organization of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], an outbreak of [[Rakghoul plague/Legends|Rakghoul plague]] emerged on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] where the Council reminded Republic citizens of a [[Level One Emergency Alert]] on the planet.
